golden.skills/release-notes/SKILL.md:
---
name: release-notes
description: >-
  Draft release notes from merged changes. Use when a maintainer says "write release notes", "draft the changelog", "summarize this release", "prepare release notes", or "list what shipped". Do NOT use for commit messages.
disable-model-invocation: true
---

# release-notes

1. Read the merged change list that the user names.
2. Group the changes by user-visible effect.
3. Write the notes as short bullets.

Done means: the notes list every merged change once.

long-sentence.skills/release-notes/SKILL.md:
---
name: release-notes
description: >-
  Draft release notes from merged changes. Use when a maintainer says "write release notes", "draft the changelog", "summarize this release", "prepare release notes", or "list what shipped". Do NOT use for commit messages.
disable-model-invocation: true
---

# release-notes

1. Read the merged change list that the user names.
2. Group the changes by user-visible effect.
3. Write the notes as short bullets and make sure that every bullet names the change and the author and the pull request and the effect on users.

Done means: the notes list every merged change once.

golden.skills/demo/SKILL.md:
---
name: demo
description: >-
  Count the open items in a task list. Use when the user asks to "count tasks", "count open items", "how many tasks", "tally the list", or "open item total". Do NOT use for editing tasks.
disable-model-invocation: true
---

# demo

1. Run `python3 scripts/count.py <file>` to count the open items in the task list file.
2. Report the count.

Report the count in one short sentence that names the file. Then stop.
